# Hardik Vatukiya — Full-Stack Developer & Software Engineer

Hardik Vatukiya is a high-performance MERN Stack and Full-Stack Developer from Rajkot, Gujarat, India. He builds fast, fully accessible (WCAG compliant), and visually stunning web applications at the intersection of design, interaction engineering, and robust backend systems.

## Core Technical Stack & Skills
- **Frontend Development**: React, Next.js (App Router), TypeScript, JavaScript (ES6+), HTML5, CSS3, Tailwind CSS.
- **Interactive & Motion Design**: GSAP (GreenSock Animation Platform), Framer Motion, smooth scroll integrations, custom scroll-trigger page states.
- **Backend & APIs**: Node.js, Express, RESTful API design, headless CMS architectures (Sanity CMS).
- **Databases**: MongoDB, PostgreSQL, SQL.
- **Developer Operations & Tooling**: Git, GitHub Actions, Vercel, npm, pnpm, SEO & Web Performance optimization, Accessibility (WCAG 2.1 compliance).

## Work Experience & Timeline
- **Freelance Full-Stack Developer** (2024 - Present): Building scalable full-stack web products, performance tuning client websites, and implementing advanced animations for international clients.
- **Full Stack Developer at Trionn** (2023 - 2024): Developed premium, award-winning interactive websites, agency landing pages, and optimized data workflows.
